intent.text: I support the pending motion moved by cost. All three participating seats (cost, indep, fam) agree on the core principle: a single independent reviewer from a different model family is the appropriate default check for the vsect plan. Cross-family diversity pierces the shared blind spots that caused 116/116 self-confirmations, while avoiding the multiplicative latency/token cost of a full council unless an irreconcilable deadlock emerges.
